title: SkyBlock Anniversary
wikitext:
{{:SkyBlock Anniversary/Countdown}} [[File:SkyBlock Anniversary Event.png|thumb|Event Icon]] {{See also|Crab Hat of Celebration}} : Not to be confused with [[New Year Celebration]], which celebrates a new SkyBlock year. The '''SkyBlock Anniversary''' is a recurring [[Events|event]] that celebrates the real-life anniversary of when SkyBlock was released to Hypixel. During the event, an NPC named [[Simon]] gives out [[Hatcessory|Hatcessories]] in the [[Hub]]. == Events == === 1st SkyBlock Anniversary: ''Party Time!'' === ''Party Time!'' was the first SkyBlock Anniversary event. It started on June 10, 2020 at 11:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time and lasted for 24 hours. * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} handed {{Item|Crab Hat of Celebration}} at the [[Event Stand]] (behind the [[Bank]]) at {{Coordinates|35|71|-48}}. * The event was called {{Pink|1st Party Time}}. === 2nd SkyBlock Anniversary === The 2nd SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2021. * There was no event or buffs. === 3rd SkyBlock Anniversary === The 3rd SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2022. It started on June 10, 2022 at 6:35 PM EDT and lasted for 7 days (168 hours). * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} handed the {{Item|Crab Hat of Celebration}} in the [[Hub]] to players. * The [[Pig Shop]] and [[Shiny Pig]] features were available to players. * A temporary 15% buff to [[Skill]] Experience for all players. === 4th SkyBlock Anniversary === The 4th SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2023. It started on June 12, 2023 at 6:15 PM EDT and lasted for 7 days (168 hours). * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} handed the {{Item|Sloth Hat of Celebration}} in the [[Hub]] to players. * The [[Pig Shop]] and [[Shiny Pig]] features were available to players, including a replacement for the {{Item|Dante's Talisman}}. * A temporary 20% buff to [[Skill]] Experience for all players. Hypixel also released a video named "4 Years of SkyBlock", and it was made available on Sunday, June 11 at 18:00 (UTC). {{YouTube|q5bjTeJ257c}} === 5th SkyBlock Anniversary === The 5th SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2024. It started on June 11, 2024 at 11:55 AM EDT and lasted for 7 days (168 hours). * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} handed out the {{Item|5th Anniversary Balloon Hat}} in the [[Hub]] to players. * The [[Pig Shop]] and [[Shiny Pig]] features were available to players. * A temporary 20% buff to [[Skill]] and [[Dungeon]] Experience for all players. === 6th SkyBlock Anniversary === The 6th SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2025, starting on June 11, 2025 at 11:55 AM EDT and lasted 7 days (168) hours. * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} handed out the {{Item|6th Anniversary Balloon Hat}} in the [[Hub]] to players. * A temporary 20% buff to [[Skill]] and [[Dungeon]] Experience as well as {{stat|mf|+10}} for all players. === 7th SkyBlock Anniversary === The 7th SkyBlock Anniversary occurred in year 2026, started on June 11, 2026 at 11:55 AM EDT and lasted 7 days (168) hours. * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} gave out{{Item|7th Anniversary Cake Hat}} to players. * A temporary 20% buff to [[Skill]] and [[Dungeon]] Experience as well as {{stat|mf|10}} for all players. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" |Condition !Message |- |rowspan="2" class="ct" |Player joins SkyBlock
during an Anniversary |class="ct" |Prior to [[#7th_SkyBlock_Anniversary|7th Anniversary]] |{{Dialogue|&b&l&kA &dHappy Anniversary! &d&l&kA &e SkyBlock is celebrating its &d[n-th] birthday&e!! &e Talk to Simon in the &bVillage &eto celebrate!}} |- |class="ct" |[[#7th_SkyBlock_Anniversary|7th Anniversary]] |{{Rmt|&eWelcome to &aHypixel Skyblock&e! &d&l7TH ANNIVERSARY! &eEarn &a+20% &eDungeons and Skill EXP and &b+10✯ Magic Find&e!}} |} ==Trivia== *In 2020, ''Party Time!'' was revealed in the [[Calendar]] 24 hours before it started. *There was no event in 2021. *For the 2022 event, [[Simon]] is situated next to the [[Colosseum]] at {{Coordinates|76|69|-44}}. * The 2022 event was originally scheduled to end on June 12, but it was extended to June 17. **At the same time as this change, the event was brought to the {{Gamemode|Stranded}} Gamemode. *The first time that the '''SkyBlock Anniversary''' and Century Celebration event will overlap will be on June 12th 2077 of real life time, in the SkyBlock Year 4100, and it will theoretically happen again every 58 years. *For the 2024 event, [[Simon]] was situated next to the [[Bazaar]] at {{Coordinates|-21|69|-78}}. *The boost to Skill Experience from this event is applied as a multiplier after all other modifiers are calculated, including {{Ench|Champion}}, [[Stats#Wisdom_Stats|Wisdom stats]], and presumably {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s ''MOAR SKILLZ!!!'' perk. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/June 9|link=none|[[File:Party Time!.png|26px]] Added the event for the first anniversary, named [[Party Time!]].}} {{History|2022/June 11|link=none|Extended the {{Pink|3rd SkyBlock Anniversary}} from 2 days to 7 days.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Events}}
